reasoningChain.evidence: The flag trial is the newly unlocked Chapter 2 progression node.
The damage roster has cleared both rescue routes and the shield trial without needing the rescued defensive heroes.
The trial visibly warns that the frontline guard's death triggers a team counterattack, so fast enough follow-through damage is important after the first kill.
The new rescue loot is support- and defense-oriented and does not clearly improve the current damage core; the flag trial provides the next relevant test.
